Offensive security background (web/API or cloud penetration testing, exploit development, CTFs) used to inform defensive design. Experience securing multi-tenant SaaS at scale, including tenant isolation and EU data residency requirements. Experience securing AI/LLM-powered features (prompt injection, agent and tool abuse, data leakage) or applying AI to security workflows such as triage and automated remediation. Core Infrastructure and Networking: Bare-metal infrastructure, virtualization (Proxmox, KVM, Kubevirt), networking, and distributed storage to maintain reliable, high-availability environments. A commitment to security and regulatory best practices in highly regulated environments, with a solid understanding of compliance controls including NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture, NIST SP 800-53r5, HIPAA, and other regulatory guidance. Self-starter with excellent communication skills who is highly motivated to grow professionally, drive meaningful company impact, and actively support and collaborate with teammates. For employees residing within 50 miles of a BrainGu office, hub location, or primary customer site, there is an expectation of on-site presence up to 5 days per week as business needs dictate. For employees residing outside this radius, the role is fully remote, and any required hub location or site visits will be governed by the Travel Requirements section. On-site schedules and location expectations may be fulfilled through an appropriate alternative arrangement based on business needs, role responsibilities, and mutual flexibility, as agreed with the company. review_candidates.description: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Position Forward Deployed Engineers sit inside the client’s problem, not next to it. You embed with an enterprise team, help find the work that actually warrants AI, learn to architect the system, build it, and help make it hold up in the real environment. This is a three-way role: consultant, operator, engineer. You will grow into pressure-testing a business case with a COO or VP of Engineering while learning to debug why an agent’s tool-calling loop degraded after a context change. The people who succeed here are fast learners who join discovery conversations on Monday and help ship what was scoped on Thursday. On this track, your focus is application engineering: you help make agents real inside the client’s actual systems, workflows, and delivery pipelines. We work with regulated industries and Fortune 500 clients who have AI mandates, real constraints, and low tolerance for demos that don’t hold up. How We Approach The Work FDEs are trusted to help shape the solution, not only deliver it. Every engagement calls for sound judgment, which you will develop over time: Reframes the request. Treats “we need an agent for X” as a hypothesis, not a spec. Decomposes the problem. Outcome → process → decisions → data → systems → actors → constraints — before choosing technology. Helps choose the intervention. Remove, simplify, traditional software, automation, LLM, RAG, agent, or multi-agent — and learns to defend why. Contributes to architecture decisions. Learns to document trade-offs (ADRs), set success metrics, and raise concerns about scope that won’t deliver value. What You'll Do Discover. Support workshops and process discovery with business and engineering stakeholders. Learn to separate genuine AI problems from workflow problems wearing an AI costume. Help bring back a scoped, well-reasoned point of view. Structure the process and the spec. For any business or engineering process being automated, help map the current state, decision points, and exceptions, then turn it into specifications that both people and AI systems can execute against reliably. Architect & design. Contribute to designing parts of agentic systems — orchestration, context and retrieval architecture, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and learning the boundaries between deterministic and non-deterministic components. Build. Help ship working systems — agents, multi-step automations, internal tooling, integration layers. You are hands-on. Prototypes that prove value in weeks, not slideware. Engineer the delivery system. Contribute to CI/CD for what you build: build, test, release, environments. Consult. Help prepare and present decisions to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and business leadership. Learn to quantify impact in their terms. Observe pre-sales scoping and proposal work when the deal calls for it. What We're Looking For Engineering foundation About 1 year of professional software development (flexible; internships and strong project work count); back-end focus, full-stack curious Working experience in one of our core ecosystems: TypeScript / Node + React, Python, .NET / C#, or Java Solid foundation in APIs, service design, and data modeling; exposure to event-driven / distributed systems College graduate (bachelor’s degree) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field Relevant certifications in cloud, software engineering, or AI (e.g., AWS or Azure associate-level, Azure AI Engineer, or equivalent) Applied AI Has built LLM or agent projects (personal, academic, or internship) beyond a basic demo Hands-on with agentic tooling: Claude Code or similar AI coding tools, agent frameworks, MCP, and tool/function calling; curiosity about multi-agent orchestration Context and spec engineering: learns to structure codebases, specifications, process definitions, and context to produce reliable, context-efficient AI output Integration literacy: is learning integration methods and options — APIs, webhooks, event streams, iPaaS (n8n, MuleSoft, etc.), MCP — and the constraints and strategies behind connecting AI to systems of record. Doesn’t need to own every integration, but is eager to learn how to design around them with guidance. Consulting & business Shows curiosity and early signs of the discovery behaviors above: business and personal drivers, constraints, stakeholder alignment, strategic questioning Interest in growing into client conversations (workshops, proposal walkthroughs, tough questions) as you gain experience Learning to translate technical decisions into business outcomes — cycle time, cost per transaction, throughput, risk reduction, ROI Strong written and verbal communication in English; comfortable learning in front of senior stakeholders Strong Plus Exposure to AI evaluation and observability: basic eval harnesses, tracing, or cost/token tracking in personal or academic projects Basic testing of AI features (e.g., simple prompt or eval tests in CI on personal or academic projects) Exposure to a regulated domain (financial services, healthcare, insurance) through coursework, projects, or internships Public portfolio of work: GitHub projects, open-source contributions, or hackathon and capstone projects involving LLMs or agents Coursework or projects in process analysis or workflow automation Internship or project experience with stakeholder-facing work, such as presenting demos or documenting solutions Comfort with ambiguity, fast learning, and switching between projects; prior internship or agency exposure is a bonus Nice To Have We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow.
